record_title: Free algebra modulo compact operators on a countable tree of ℓp spaces
provenance: An explicit binary-tree direct sum of classical sequence spaces supports two weighted strictly singular shifts whose classes modulo compact operators freely generate a non-unital associative algebra.
limitations: Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge. Targeted searches found no equivalent countable-tree/free-algebra theorem. Milman's 1970 Russian-language primary article and Pietsch's classical operator-ideal monograph were not exhaustively inspected; an equivalent result may exist under different infinite-direct-sum or free-semigroup terminology.
